body.name: Unrestricted categorical causal model
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_{d,\epsilon}=\{P: X\in[d], A,Y,Y(0),Y(1)\in\{0,1\}, P\text{ satisfies }\mathrm{ass:consistency},\mathrm{ass:conditional\mbox{-}exchangeability},\mathrm{ass:fixed\mbox{-}overlap}\}\) for every \(d\ge2\) and fixed \(0<\epsilon<1/2\).
